name: benchmark-nq
description: Benchmark-NQ evaluates open-domain question answering performance on questions derived from the Natural Questions dataset, measuring a model's ability to produce accurate short and long answers from text. It focuses on extractive and generative QA performance in realistic question-answering settings. The benchmark is used to assess both retrieval+reading pipelines and end-to-end generative QA systems.
reputation: Widely used QA benchmark derived from Natural Questions, commonly employed to evaluate retrieval and reading-comprehension models.
